remarks: Experience 100 acres of country living on this exceptional property featuring with acreage and a picturesque creek.   Relax on the inviting full front porch and enjoy the peaceful rural setting. Inside, you'll find numerous updates including new Anderson windows and a new heating boiler. The kitchen features granite countertops, while the first-floor laundry room offers abundant cabinet space for added convenience. Filtered water and a reverse osmosis system provide enhanced water quality throughout the home.The spacious living and dining rooms include room-size area rugs, and upstairs, a large bonus living area between the bedrooms offers flexible space for a home office, recreation room, or sitting area. Unwind in the Jacuzzi bathtub after a long day.The washer and dryer, along with the electric fireplace and TV stand, are optional and may be included with an acceptable offer.Whether you're looking for room to spread out, modern updates, or the tranquility of a rural setting, this property offers a unique combination of comfort, functionality, and outdoor enjoyment. Property has been divided. 75-foot barn on the other side of the road has been sold.
